source: new: a bound leaf (template on item.book-villagers-journal) in the count-box
name: Rows-For-Another's Leaf
text: Rows-For-Another, boat-hand. Holed the second boat off the bank: four nushmeekos. [The next lines are in a small, exact hand.] First year: bread, roof, net and the boat's upkeep, eleven; worked, six. A fever in the rains: one more. Second year: the same. [From the third year the hand is larger, and the same line runs on for nine years more.] Owed at the last reckoning: sixty nushmeekos.

source: new: the last leaf in the count-box (template on item.book-villagers-journal)
name: The Keeper's Leaf
text: Hulm-Tei, hatched owing on this ground. What any leaf is short at the reckoning is written here. If this leaf is lost, the shortfall is shared among all. Under it, eleven shortfalls in his own hand: a runaway's two seasons, a drowned hand's four, a boat lost, a fever's months; none of them Rows-For-Another's.
